title: fab0 claim, schema 2 (runs/<project>/<run>/ledger/<step>[-<unit>]-<attempt>-claim.yaml in the run store)
description: Who took one attempt of a unit: a create-only fact `next` writes and pushes before it hands the attempt out. The first claim pushed stands; a machine whose claim lost doesn't hand the attempt out.

actor.description: The tracker user who took it.

machine.description: The checkout that took it: an id kept in the home repo's git directory, so the same checkout knows its own claim.
